symptoms: Water-soaked dark brown discoloration at vine collar region; sudden wilting and yellowing of foliage
management: Drench vine root zone with 0.5% Bordeaux mixture or Metalaxyl @ 2 g/L
prevention: Provide good drainage in betelvine conservatory (bareja)

healthy_signs: Glossy, turgid leaves with deep green pigmentation and no necrotic spots
Firm stems with healthy node development
Vigorous climbing vines or canopies with strong root anchorage
Clean foliage free from sucking pest colonies or sooty mold
management: Isolate affected plants and eliminate debris from previous seasons
Provide adequate light and airflow to discourage fungal sporulation
Consult local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) for exact regional prescription
prevention: Ensure good drainage and aeration around vine roots or tree bases
Apply well-decomposed FYM enriched with biocontrol agents (Trichoderma + Pseudomonas)
Maintain clean field hygiene and avoid working in wet crops to prevent spore spread
Use resistant varieties recommended by regional Agricultural Universities
